title: Gaadandhakaramulo – Sharon Sisters Telugu christian song
telugu: ప్రభు యేసు కృప నన్ను ఎడబాయక కాపాడును
నీ కృప నన్ను విడువదు నీ నిబంధన మారదు
english: Kanti paapa vale nannu kunukaaka kaapaadunu
Prabhu Yesu krupa nannu edabaayaka kaapaadunu
Nee krupa nannu viduvadu nee nibandhana maaradu
translation: I will not be shaken, nor will I fear, while my Jesus is with me.
In the times when I walk through deep, thick darkness,
He protects me like the apple of His eye without slumbering.
I will sing praises to the Lord Jesus all through my life.
When You are present in my boat which is tossed and battered by the waves,
The grace of Lord Jesus protects me, never leaving my side.
Giving me assurance and comfort, He will safely guide me to the shore.
Even in the times when I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
Your loving hand comforts and sustains me.
Filling me with the Holy Spirit, He leads me onward.
Though the mountains depart and the hills are shaken,
Your grace will never leave me, and Your covenant will not change.
Your everlasting peace will continually guide me.

credits.Vocals: Philip Gariki & Sharon Philip & JK Christopher & Lillian Christopher & Joel Sam & Hana Joyce

intro: Gaadandhakaramulo is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Phebe Joseph, sung by Philip Gariki, Sharon Philip, JK Christopher, Lillian Christopher, Joel Sam, Hana Joyce and music composed by JK Christopher. This song was released on May 18, 2026 through Sharon Sisters Youtube Channel
